title: item
description: Hub to phone, once welcomed: an Item for the Attention Queue, such as an agent that has become blocked. The phone runs the `speak_item` Primitive: in the next Silence it plays an earcon and says `say`, never over the person's speech. Items waiting together are said as one machine Turn, after one earcon. Changes the hub sees together arrive as one Item. Once the Item has been said, the phone sends `item_spoken` with its `id`. On every new connection the hub sends again each Item not yet spoken that still holds (its agent is still blocked), and a phone ignores an Item whose `id` it has already queued: a reconnect never repeats an alert. A muted Bucket raises no Items.

id.description: Chosen by the hub, unique across its restarts; what the phone deduplicates on.

buckets.description: The Descriptor ids of the Buckets the Item is about: more than one when changes were merged.

say.description: One short sentence for a person, fit to be spoken after the earcon.
